title: [RPG Design Guides] Difficulty ②: Brutal Difficulty

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】難易度② 凶悪な難易度
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Difficulty ②: Brutal Difficulty

blocks.source: 市販ＲＰＧの中には、部分的あるいは全般的に凶悪な難しさを持つものがある。せっかくなので、僕が凶悪だと思ったゲームバランスの例をまとめてみた。この中には誰もが知っている有名作品も珍しくない。
blocks.translation: Some commercial RPGs have brutally difficult sections or are brutally difficult overall. Since I had the opportunity, I compiled some examples of game balance that I considered brutal. Quite a few of these are famous works that everyone knows.

blocks.source: 凶悪な難易度の作品一覧
blocks.translation: Works with Brutal Difficulty

blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト２： ブリザード、デビルロード、バズズ
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest II: Blizzards, Devil Road, and Pazuzu

blocks.source: ３人パーティで、蘇生手段も限られた状態で、ザラキ、メガンテなどの全体即死攻撃を使用する魔物達。難しいを通り越して、もはや理不尽の領域。ちなみに、ファミコン版だと戦闘中に蘇生（ザオリク、世界樹の葉）はできない。
blocks.translation: Monsters that use party-wide instant-death attacks such as Thwack and Kamikazee against a three-person party with limited means of revival. It goes beyond difficult and enters the realm of pure unfairness. Incidentally, in the Famicom version, revival (Kazing or a Leaf of the World Tree) is not possible during battle.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー： 氷の洞窟
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy: Ice Cave

blocks.source: 全体即死のクラウダを使用するダークウィザード。全体マヒのマインドブラストと即死攻撃を使用するマインドフレイア。石化攻撃のコカトリス。それらが１つのダンジョンに出現する脅威。
blocks.translation: Dark Wizards use Bane, which instantly kills the entire party. Mindflayers use Mind Blast, which paralyzes the entire party, as well as instant-death attacks. Cockatrices use petrification attacks. The threat of all of them appearing in a single dungeon.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー３： ラストダンジョン
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy III: The Final Dungeon

blocks.source: 合計２～４時間程度かかるラストダンジョンだが、セーブポイントが存在しない。ラスボスを倒すためには、その前に凶悪なボス達を倒さなければならないが、うっかり、その前にラスボスに挑むと絶対に勝つことができず今までの時間がパーになる。
blocks.translation: The final dungeon takes roughly two to four hours in total, yet contains no save point. To defeat the final boss, you must first defeat a series of brutally difficult bosses. If you accidentally challenge the final boss before doing so, victory is absolutely impossible, and all the time you spent is wasted.

blocks.source: ＦＦ３は「全滅＝ゲームオーバー」のＲＰＧだが、全滅しても所持金半分で復活できるＤＱ３，４よりも圧倒的に厳しい。製作者も本当はセーブポイントを用意していたのだが、バイトのデバッガーが簡単すぎるといったため、撤廃されたとか何とか。
blocks.translation: FFIII is an RPG where “party wipe = game over,” making it overwhelmingly harsher than DQIII and IV, where you can revive after a party wipe with half your money. The developers had actually prepared a save point, but apparently removed it after a part-time debugger said it made the game too easy.

blocks.source: 当前、一般に向けてＲＰＧを作成するなら、生粋のヘビーユーザを基準にバランスを設定してはならない。
blocks.translation: Today, when creating an RPG for a general audience, you must not set the balance based on hardcore players.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジータクティクス： ウィーグラフ＆ベリアス戦
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Wiegraf & Velius Battle

blocks.source: 主人公ラムザとウィーグラフとの１対１のバトルだが、有効な装備やアビリティがないと、まず確実に負ける。予備のセーブデータを取っていないとハマる可能性大。
blocks.translation: It is a one-on-one battle between the protagonist Ramza and Wiegraf, and without effective equipment or abilities, you will almost certainly lose. If you have not made a backup save, there is a high chance you will get stuck.

blocks.source: というか、筆者はハメられて最初からやり直した。(失ったプレイ時間３０時間！)
blocks.translation: In fact, I was caught by this trap and had to start over from the beginning. (Thirty hours of playtime lost!)

blocks.source: ウィーグラフを倒すとベリアスに変身するが、これがまたも強敵。しかし、今度は１対１ではないので、色々と対策が立てられるのが救い。
blocks.translation: Wiegraf transforms into Velius after you defeat him, and Velius is yet another formidable opponent. However, this time it is not a one-on-one fight, so you can develop various countermeasures, which is a saving grace.

blocks.source: ロマンシングサガ： イフリート、フルフル、ラルバ
blocks.translation: Romancing SaGa: Ifrit, Fafnir, and Lalah

blocks.source: イフリートの火の鳥、フルフルの吹雪、ラルバのダークウェブは耐性を持たないパーティを一撃で全滅させる。（しかも、耐性装備は入手機会が限られる。ダークウェブは対策不能）これらが、後半はザコ敵として堂々と出現するのがロマサガ１クオリティ。
blocks.translation: Ifrit’s Fire Bird, Fafnir’s Blizzard, and Lalah’s Dark Web can wipe out a party without resistance in a single attack. (Moreover, opportunities to obtain equipment with resistances are limited, and Dark Web cannot be countered.) Having these enemies appear openly as regular monsters in the latter half is quintessential Romancing SaGa 1.

blocks.source: どこでもセーブのおかげで、意外とどうにかなるが、うっかりイベントの途中でセーブすると、ボスを倒せずハマリになることも……。
blocks.translation: Thanks to being able to save anywhere, you can manage somehow more often than expected. However, if you accidentally save in the middle of an event, you may become stuck because you can no longer defeat the boss...

blocks.source: というか、筆者はイフリートにハメられて最初からやり直した。
blocks.translation: In fact, I was trapped by Ifrit and had to start over from the beginning.

blocks.source: ロマンシングサガ２： ラスボス戦
blocks.translation: Romancing SaGa 2: The Final Boss Battle

blocks.source: とてつもない攻撃回数を持ったＲＰＧ史上最強とも言われるラスボス。攻撃の組み合わせが悪ければ、即全滅する。救済処置のクイックタイムの術で動きを止めればノーダメージで勝てるが、せっかくのラスボス戦が一方的なハメ殺しとは空しいもの。リヴァイヴァ、光の壁などの補助術を活用すれば、クイックタイムなしでもどうにか勝てるらしい。
blocks.translation: A final boss said to be the strongest in RPG history, with an outrageous number of attacks. A bad combination of attacks can wipe out the entire party instantly. You can win without taking damage by stopping its movement with the emergency measure known as the Quick Time spell, but it is a hollow experience when the long-awaited final boss battle becomes a one-sided exploit. Apparently, you can somehow win without Quick Time by making use of support spells such as Reviver and Light Wall.

blocks.source: 酷いラスボスの例として挙げてみたけど、上下の調整不足と違い、きっちり調整した上での確信犯だと思われる。
blocks.translation: I have cited this as an example of a terrible final boss, but unlike cases of inadequate adjustment between being too weak and too strong, this seems to be a deliberate choice made after careful balancing.

blocks.source: スターオーシャン２： ミカエル＆ハニエル戦
blocks.translation: Star Ocean: The Second Story: The Michael & Haniel Battle

blocks.source: ミカエルのスピキュール（火属性全体攻撃）連発が超凶悪。おまけに戦闘アニメも長い。火属性を無効化できる装備が存在するが、装備できる仲間は限られる。入手方法もやや難しいので、攻略情報を持たないプレイヤーは死ねる。
blocks.translation: Michael’s repeated Spicule attacks (party-wide fire-element attacks) are extraordinarily brutal. To make matters worse, the battle animation is also long. Equipment that nullifies fire-element attacks exists, but only a limited number of party members can equip it. Since the method of obtaining it is also somewhat difficult, players without a guide are doomed.

blocks.source: 女神異聞録ペルソナ： ラストダンジョン
blocks.translation: Revelations: Persona: The Final Dungeon

blocks.source: 道順を知らないと、ラスボス戦と合わせて５時間以上かかる凶悪なラストダンジョン。しかも、一切のセーブ不可。ＦＦ３を遥かに凌駕する恐るべしラストダンジョンである。ヘビーユーザ向けといわれるメガテンシリーズの中でも突出している。
blocks.translation: A brutally difficult final dungeon that takes more than five hours, including the final boss battle, if you do not know the route. What’s more, saving is completely impossible. It is a truly terrifying final dungeon that far surpasses FFIII, even standing out among the Megami Tensei series, which is said to be aimed at hardcore players.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 中には「ちゃんとテストプレイしたのか？」そもそも「プレイヤーにクリアしてもらう気が本当にあるのか？」ということも疑われる難易度もある。ところが、上記のことが理由で、これらの作品が軒並みク○ゲー認定されているかというと、そうではないようだ。むしろ、作品をクリアしたプレイヤーからは、
blocks.translation: Some difficulty levels make you wonder, “Did they actually test-play this properly?” or even, “Did they really intend for players to clear the game?” However, these works do not all seem to have been labeled bad games because of the issues mentioned above. If anything, players who cleared them sometimes even regard them as

blocks.source: 「いい思い出」
blocks.translation: "good memories"

blocks.source: とすら思われている節もある。
blocks.translation: in their own way.

blocks.source: ＦＦ３がＤＳでリメイクされた際には、
blocks.translation: When FFIII was remade for the DS,

blocks.source: 「凶悪なラストダンジョンはそのままにしてくれ！」
blocks.translation: "Leave the brutally difficult final dungeon as it is!"

blocks.source: という要望が多く、多少難易度が落ちたものの、期待に応えて、セーブポイントは設置されなかった。ＤＱ２に至っては、製作者の堀井氏が時間の都合でテストプレイをまともにできなかったことを明言しているが、それでもこの難易度でなくては駄目だという人もいたりする。
blocks.translation: was a common request. Although the difficulty was reduced somewhat, the developers met those expectations by not adding any save points. As for DQII, its creator, Mr. Horii, has openly stated that he was unable to properly test-play it due to time constraints, yet some people still insist that anything less than this level of difficulty would not do.

blocks.source: というように、意外とプレイヤーの難易度への許容量は大きい。どちらかというと、ロード時間が長かったり、エンカウント率が高かったりと、難易度以外の不快要素が原因でクリアを諦めるプレイヤーが多いようだ。クリアできる難易度でさえあれば、後は快適性などの向上に時間を割くのも手だろう。とはいえ、
blocks.translation: As you can see, players’ tolerance for difficulty is surprisingly high. If anything, many players seem to give up on clearing a game because of unpleasant elements unrelated to difficulty, such as long loading times or high encounter rates. As long as the difficulty remains manageable, it may be wise to spend the rest of your time improving convenience and similar aspects. That said,

blocks.source: ハマリだけは起こらないようにするべきなのは言うまでもない。
blocks.translation: it goes without saying that you should ensure players never become stuck.

blocks.source: もっとも、上のようなバランスすら喜ぶのは、ヘビーユーザが中心である点には気をつけておきたい。ヘビーユーザというのは、声が大きく実数以上によく目立つもの。マニアックな方向を狙うのも結構だけど、一般向けを狙う場合は気をつけよう。
blocks.translation: However, keep in mind that hardcore players are the main group who even enjoy balance like the examples above. Hardcore players tend to be vocal and stand out far more than their actual numbers would suggest. There is nothing wrong with targeting a niche audience, but be careful when aiming for a general audience.

blocks.source: また、ファミコン時代とは異なりＲＰＧの物語の量は増大しているため、難易度を高くすると、より時間がかかってしまう。近年、増加している時間のない社会人プレイヤーの声も無視できない。
blocks.translation: Also, unlike in the Famicom era, the amount of story content in RPGs has increased substantially, so raising the difficulty makes the game take even longer. We cannot ignore the voices of working adult players, who have increasingly little free time in recent years.

blocks.source: 特にフリーソフトの場合は序盤のバランスがきついと、即効でゴミ箱行きになることが多い。注意しよう。
blocks.translation: Especially in the case of freeware, if the balance is too harsh at the beginning, the game is often sent straight to the recycle bin. Be careful.
